title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!


Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.


Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA.
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.


Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.


Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Director of Marketing | Hotel Technology Experience Required
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next-generation, AI-native platform for the hospitality industry. Looking for a Director of Marketing who understands hotels, understands technology, and knows how to turn that knowledge into real growth.


This role is ideal for someone who has marketed to hotel decision-makers before and enjoys building campaigns, writing compelling content, and generating measurable demand.


About the Role

We’re building something special for the hotel industry, and we’re looking for a Director of Marketing who feels at home in the world of hotel technology.


If you’ve spent meaningful time marketing to hoteliers, understand how hotel decision-makers think, and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to create campaigns that drive pipeline, you’ll thrive in this role.


This is a hands-on, full-funnel leadership role responsible for building and scaling our marketing engine. You will oversee demand generation, product marketing, content creation, and go-to-market strategy while working closely with Sales to drive qualified leads and revenue growth.


The hospitality industry values clarity, trust, and solutions that make operations easier. We’re looking for someone who knows how to communicate exactly that.


What You’ll Be Doing

Develop a deep understanding of the hotel ecosystem, including independent hotels, management companies, and brand-affiliated properties.


Stay closely connected to the needs and priorities of hotel decision-makers such as:

  • General Managers
  • Directors of Sales and Marketing
  • Revenue Managers
  • Digital marketing leaders
  • IT leaders


Use these insights to shape messaging, positioning, and campaigns that resonate with hotel operators.


Owning the Marketing Engine

Build and manage the full marketing funnel—from awareness through lead generation, nurturing, and conversion to sales.


Key areas include:

  • Demand generation strategy
  • SEO and digital acquisition
  • Email and lifecycle marketing
  • Webinars and industry events
  • Campaign development and execution


Your goal is to ensure marketing consistently generates qualified pipeline for the sales team.


Leading Blog and Thought Leadership Strategy

Own and grow the company’s blog and thought leadership presence to establish authority in the hospitality technology space and drive inbound demand.


This includes:

  • Writing and overseeing blog content focused on hotel industry trends and insights
  • Creating thought leadership around topics like AI in hospitality, guest engagement, and direct booking strategies
  • Developing SEO-driven blog content that attracts hotel decision-makers researching solutions
  • Implement AI Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies to ensure the company and its content are discoverable through AI agents like Copilot, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging AI-driven discovery platforms.
  • Repurposing blog content into campaigns, LinkedIn posts, webinars, and sales materials


Creating Content That Speaks the Hotel Industry’s Language

Develop and oversee content that resonates with hospitality leaders, including:

  • Blog articles and thought leadership pieces
  • Industry guides and educational resources
  • Case studies and ROI stories
  • Campaign messaging and landing pages
  • Sales enablement materials


The goal is content that feels authentic, practical, and directly relevant to hotel operators , while positioning the company as a trusted voice in hospitality technology.


Becoming Deeply Fluent in the Product

You will develop strong product knowledge and become fluent in how the platform works.


This includes understanding:

  • How the product integrates into the hotel technology stack
  • The operational problems it solves for hotel teams
  • The value it creates for revenue growth and guest engagement


This fluency will help shape messaging, positioning, and product launches.


Partnering Closely with Sales

Marketing and sales alignment is critical in this role.


You will work closely with the sales team to:

  • Align on pipeline and growth targets
  • Develop campaigns that generate qualified opportunities
  • Support sales with content, messaging, and materials
  • Continuously improve lead quality and funnel performance


Using Data to Drive Decisions

Track performance across the funnel and continuously improve marketing efficiency.


You will analyze:

  • Lead generation performance
  • Campaign ROI
  • Funnel conversion metrics
  • Customer acquisition trends


Marketing should be measurable, predictable, and scalable.


Success in This Role

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to build a scalable marketing engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline.


Key outcomes include:

  • Growth in marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline
  • Consistent generation of qualified leads for the sales team
  • Increased inbound demand through SEO, blog content, and thought leadership
  • Strong campaign performance across webinars, events, and digital channels
  • Clear and compelling positioning that resonates with hotel decision-makers


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience marketing to hotels or within the hospitality technology ecosystem
  • Experience in B2B SaaS marketing and demand generation
  • Proven ability to generate qualified pipeline and measurable revenue impact
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, including blogs and thought leadership content
  • Ability to translate complex technology into clear, compelling messaging
  • Comfort operating both strategically and hands-on
  • Experience collaborating closely with sales teams in a pipeline-driven environment
  • Interest in AI-driven platforms, automation, and emerging technology transforming hospitality


Experience at or working with hospitality technology platforms such as hotel CRM, guest engagement, marketing automation, revenue management, or hotel operations platforms is highly valued.


Why You Might Love This Role

You enjoy understanding how an industry works and building marketing that speaks directly to it.


You like owning the entire marketing engine , not just one channel.


You enjoy turning insight, content, and campaigns into measurable growth.


You want to help shape how the hospitality industry adopts the next generation of technology.


Why Join Us

You’ll be joining a modern AI-native product company that is helping reshape how hotels understand their guests, grow direct bookings, and operate more intelligently.


This is a rare opportunity to help introduce AI-powered guest engagement and marketing technology to the hospitality industry while building a marketing engine that drives real growth.


Your work will directly influence:

  • How the industry understands our product
  • How we position ourselves in the market
  • How we generate scalable demand


You won’t just run campaigns—you’ll help define how a new category of hospitality technology is introduced to the market and adopted by hotel leaders around the world.


If you’re energized by hospitality, great products, and building a marketing engine that truly moves the needle, we’d love to meet you.

You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You’ll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You’ve got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.


WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH


You’ll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You’ll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING


  • Build and execute our BD strategy across the LATAM with a focus on financial institutions, platforms and enterprise clients.
  • Maintain a high-quality pipeline across identified target verticals, focusing on high-impact deals, and think through supporting business development strategies.
  • Own the full sales cycle for closing new partners – from sourcing and qualification to leading the definition of the solution for the partner and negotiating the commercials, all the way through to go-live.
  • Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
  • Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
  • Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
  • Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the LATAM market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
  • Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.
  • Be the voice of the UK market internally – and help drive what comes next.


WHAT YOU BRING


  • Track record in BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales in fintech or financial services:
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions or regulated entities
  • Fluency in the world of payments, FX, embedded finance, or APIs.
  • Strategic thinker, hands-on doer, data-driven operator.
  • Able to speak the language of product, compliance, and commercial teams.


WHO YOU ARE


  • Educated with a relevant degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
  • Customer-focused, you can’t imagine working in any other way, and it’s the only way to achieve our goals.
  • Equally at home in both strategic planning and hands-on execution, ideally with experience in start-up/scale-up as well as larger organisations.
  • Ability to drill down, persistent and never-give-up spirit.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute high-impact business development strategies.
  • Strong consultative sales approach and experience negotiating with enterprise C-level executives.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills – able to influence internal and external stakeholders

title: Senior Database Engineer / Lead DBA (DB2 LUW & Cloud Migration) – Bilingual (EN/PT)
description:
We are hiring for a USA company:


Senior Database Engineer / Lead DBA (DB2 LUW & Cloud Migration) – Bilingual (EN/PT)


About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to join our Global Mainframe DB2 LUW team. This is not a typical application development role; we are looking for a \"under-the-hood\" expert who understands database internals, performance optimization, and the complexities of migrating data between NoSQL and Relational environments.

As a technical lead, you will manage high-stakes backend operations, automate audit compliance, and guide the team through complex data mapping and environment refreshes.

What You Will Do

  • Core Administration: Perform deep-dive backend management of DB2 LUW (Linux, Unix, Windows) environments.
  • Environment Management: Execute test environment refreshes and manage data flow from Archive (AR) environments into active test streams.
  • Modernization & Migration: Lead the charge in migrating data from NoSQL to Relational databases, focusing on complex data mapping, relationship building, and schema design.
  • Cloud & NoSQL: Manage tasks related to AWS RDS and NoSQL platforms, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Automation & Compliance: Develop automation scripts for audit compliance and security protocols.
  • Performance Tuning: Act as the subject matter expert for advanced SQL tuning and database optimization.
  • Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and leadership to junior and mid-level engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in both English and Portuguese is mandatory.
  • Mainframe DB2 LUW
  • Expertise in DB2 LUW: Extensive experience in backend DB2 LUW administration (not just interfacing via apps).
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record of migrating data between different architectures (Relational vs. NoSQL).
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Amazon RDS and NoSQL databases.
  • Advanced Tuning: Expert-level ability to diagnose and resolve complex SQL performance issues.
  • Location: Remote friendly—we value your skillset over your physical location.

title: ESPECIALISTA SISTEMAS SAP TM
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional.   • Conhecimento em suporte ao módulo SAP TM (Transportation Management)
  • Experiência em suporte AMS no módulo TM nos processos de Planejamento de Fretes através do Sistema SAP TM;

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de QA com foco em garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções desenvolvidas pela Klavi. Essa pessoa atuará de forma colaborativa com os times de produto e engenharia, contribuindo para a definição de cenários de teste, automação de testes, identificação e prevenção de bugs em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas entregas atendam aos mais altos padrões de qualidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência para os usuários finais.


Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.
  • Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.
  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.


Salário

  • Regime: PJ
  • Salário: Competitivo
  • Nível: Especialista


Principais responsabilidades

  • Investigar e diagnosticar falhas, identificando a causa raiz de bugs e inconsistências no sistema.
  • Criar suítes de testes com base nos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais das features.
  • Implementar testes automatizados para garantir a cobertura e a confiabilidade de novas funcionalidades.
  • Validar o estado do sistema antes de implantações, garantindo que todos os ambientes estejam estáveis e prontos para release.
  • Ter um entendimento profundo dos fluxos atuais do sistema para antecipar riscos e propor melhorias de qualidade.
  • Monitorar continuamente a saúde e o desempenho das aplicações, atuando preventivamente em casos de instabilidade.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Inglês avançado – Será necessário para se comunicar com times internacionais, participar de reuniões técnicas e colaborar em projetos globais.
  • Formação acadêmica na área de computação – Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com os testes automatizados
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial – Atuação no escritório da Klavi em São Paulo, em modelo híbrido ou presencial, conforme combinado.
  • Tech Stack: Python, Java, Golang, AWS (EKS, SQS, SNS), PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Git, Jenkins, Grafana


Nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash benefícios: Vale Refeição, Alimentação e Auxílio Home Office;
  • Licença Parental estendida: a licença maternidade é de 6 meses e a licença parental é de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Incentivo a educação;
  • Gympass;
  • Day Off aniversário;
  • Chat GPT Pro;
  • Bônus.

title: Consultor Funcional SAP, Testes, Negócios
description:
CHAMADA ÚNICA – BOOTCAMP SAP CCS|PROGRAMA DE CAPACITAÇÃO


Não perca a oportunidade de fazer parte de um Programa de Capacitação exclusivo para um processo de seleção do BOOTCAMP SAP CCS - Customer Care & Service.

Confira abaixo os detalhes e requisitos mínimos para a sua inscrição:


O que é SAP CCS?

O CCS é a solução da SAP voltada para gestão do ciclo de relacionamento com clientes, muito usada em empresas de Utilities (energia, água, gás, telecom). Ele cobre todo o ciclo de atendimento: do primeiro contato do cliente até faturamento, cobrança e serviços técnicos em campo.


O que é o Bootcamp?

Um programa intensivo de capacitação voltado à formação de consultores SAP.

Requisitos mínimos para participar:

Ter, no mínimo, 3 anos de experiência profissional como:

Analista de negócios com foco em processos de atendimento a cliente em empresas de utilties: cadastro de clientes, faturamento, gestão de ordem de serviço, contas a pagar e a receber.

Analista de TI com experiência em aplicações similares ao SAP CCS no atendimento às empresas de utilities.

Analista de negócio SAP ECC ou S4Hana (Key User) nos módulos CCS em empresa de utilities (água, gás, energia, telecom).

Analista funcional de TI ou consultor funcional SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos SD, FI, PM/PS.

Desenvolvedor SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos CCS, SD, FI, PM/PS com forte base técnica e algum conhecimento funcional destes módulos SAP.


Conhecimentos obrigatórios em pelo menos 2 das 4 áreas abaixo:

Billing: gestão dos diversos ciclos de faturamento por segmento de cliente, geração das faturas/contas, impressão etc

Contract Account: gestão da conta (débitos, créditos, faturas e pagamentos etc) e do contrato com o cliente (Tarifas, datas, status do serviço etc).

Device Management: gestão dos ativos (ex. medidores, locais de instalação). ordens de serviço (instalação, troca, verificação, retirada, histórico etc), leitura de consumo (real, estimada, ajustes)

Sistemas de Informação em Utilities: uso de SAP CCS ou ERPs similares ou custom para empresas do segmento.


Vantagens de participar:

Crescente demanda com a migração para o SAP S/4HANA em empresas de Utilities

Crescimento profissional acelerado e remuneração competitiva

Programa 100% gratuito para os comprometidos

Possibilidade de contratação pela Etho ou parceiros ao final do treinamento


Informações importantes:


Duração: 8 semanas consecutivas, 3 dias por semana: às 2af, 3af, e 5af.

3 horas por sessão, período noturno.


Idioma: não é requerido, mas se tiver aumentam suas chances de participação


Etapas do processo: Triagem|Teste de Raciocínio Lógico|Entrevistas RH e Técnicas


Localização: residir em qualquer lugar do Brasil, preferencialmente para a região de SP, RJ e BH.


Participação: Formação Custeada Integralmente


Se você atende aos requisitos mínimos, envie seu currículo para:

Assunto do e-mail:(Bootcamp SAP CCS)

title: Category Manager
description:
We are hiring an analytically elite Category Manager / Category Analyst to serve as the commercial intelligence engine for a fast-growing CPG brand scaling from. This role blends deep category analytics, trade optimization, and retail strategy with storytelling that drives better decisions — internally and with key partners.


You will transform complex datasets — syndicated data (SPINS, Nielsen, IRI), retailer portals (e.g., 84.51°), distributor reporting, and internal systems — into actionable insights that meaningfully improve velocity, trade efficiency, pricing, and distribution performance. This person is the strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, and Leadership.


Strategic Importance


  • As we scale nationally and deepen relationships with major retailers and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), this role is critical to commercial success by:
  • Elevating category insights as a competitive advantage
  • Strengthening sales pitches with data-backed stories that win distribution
  • Increasing promo ROI through rigorous trade and lift analysis
  • Driving cross-functional alignment on strategy via clear analytics + narratives
  • This role is not just about dashboards — it’s about impact and influence across the business.



Key Responsibilities


  • Syndicated Data + Retailer Insights
  • Own analysis of SPINS, Nielsen/IRI and retailer portal data to understand:
  • Category growth drivers
  • Competitor dynamics
  • Velocity and share trends
  • Translate data into retailer-specific insights for buyers and commercial teams.


Promotion & Trade Effectiveness


  • Measure incremental lift, promo effectiveness, and trade ROI.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to improve TPM discipline, promotional forecasting and post mortems.
  • Create frameworks to compare promo results vs. baseline and forecast.


Assortment, Pricing, and Space Strategy


  • Recommend SKU rationalization, pricing strategies, and assortment optimization.
  • Partner with Sales/Category buyers on planogram space recommendations.


Distributor & Retail Performance Tracking

Track performance across key channels and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), including:


  • Fill rates
  • Retail sell-through
  • Inventory health and void risk


Provide early-warning signals and corrective action recommendations.

Forecasting & Demand Planning Support


  • Improve forecast accuracy and alignment with Supply Chain and Finance.
  • Provide insights that enhance S&OP and promotional planning.


Cross-Functional Analytics & Reporting

Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards in Power BI / Tableau.


Provide cadence reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) tailored to:


  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations


Executive Storytelling & Data Communication


  • Translate analytics into structured business narratives that inform strategy and execution.
  • Support pitch materials, competitive heatmaps, and retailer presentations.


Required Experience & Skills


Experience


  • 3–8+ years in CPG analytics, category management, revenue management, or related retail strategy roles.


Proven track record with:


  • Syndicated data platforms (SPINS, Nielsen/IRI)
  • Retailer portals (84.51°, Luminate)
  • Commercial analytics in a growth CPG environment


Technical Skills


  • Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data transformations)
  • Power BI / Tableau dashboard creation
  • Familiarity with trade spend economics, TPM, and promotional lift frameworks


Capabilities


  • Strong analytical rigor and ability to build structured insights
  • Excellent communication and executive presence
  • Storytelling that transforms data into selling narratives


Preferred Experience


  • Experience in frozen or high-velocity CPG categories
  • Prior work with national retailers and major distributors
  • Startup or high-growth CPG environment

title: Category Manager
description:
We are hiring an analytically elite Category Manager / Category Analyst to serve as the commercial intelligence engine for a fast-growing CPG brand scaling from. This role blends deep category analytics, trade optimization, and retail strategy with storytelling that drives better decisions — internally and with key partners.


You will transform complex datasets — syndicated data (SPINS, Nielsen, IRI), retailer portals (e.g., 84.51°), distributor reporting, and internal systems — into actionable insights that meaningfully improve velocity, trade efficiency, pricing, and distribution performance. This person is the strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, and Leadership.


Strategic Importance


  • As we scale nationally and deepen relationships with major retailers and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), this role is critical to commercial success by:
  • Elevating category insights as a competitive advantage
  • Strengthening sales pitches with data-backed stories that win distribution
  • Increasing promo ROI through rigorous trade and lift analysis
  • Driving cross-functional alignment on strategy via clear analytics + narratives
  • This role is not just about dashboards — it’s about impact and influence across the business.



Key Responsibilities


  • Syndicated Data + Retailer Insights
  • Own analysis of SPINS, Nielsen/IRI and retailer portal data to understand:
  • Category growth drivers
  • Competitor dynamics
  • Velocity and share trends
  • Translate data into retailer-specific insights for buyers and commercial teams.


Promotion & Trade Effectiveness


  • Measure incremental lift, promo effectiveness, and trade ROI.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to improve TPM discipline, promotional forecasting and post mortems.
  • Create frameworks to compare promo results vs. baseline and forecast.


Assortment, Pricing, and Space Strategy


  • Recommend SKU rationalization, pricing strategies, and assortment optimization.
  • Partner with Sales/Category buyers on planogram space recommendations.


Distributor & Retail Performance Tracking

Track performance across key channels and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), including:


  • Fill rates
  • Retail sell-through
  • Inventory health and void risk


Provide early-warning signals and corrective action recommendations.

Forecasting & Demand Planning Support


  • Improve forecast accuracy and alignment with Supply Chain and Finance.
  • Provide insights that enhance S&OP and promotional planning.


Cross-Functional Analytics & Reporting

Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards in Power BI / Tableau.


Provide cadence reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) tailored to:


  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations


Executive Storytelling & Data Communication


  • Translate analytics into structured business narratives that inform strategy and execution.
  • Support pitch materials, competitive heatmaps, and retailer presentations.


Required Experience & Skills


Experience


  • 3–8+ years in CPG analytics, category management, revenue management, or related retail strategy roles.


Proven track record with:


  • Syndicated data platforms (SPINS, Nielsen/IRI)
  • Retailer portals (84.51°, Luminate)
  • Commercial analytics in a growth CPG environment


Technical Skills


  • Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data transformations)
  • Power BI / Tableau dashboard creation
  • Familiarity with trade spend economics, TPM, and promotional lift frameworks


Capabilities


  • Strong analytical rigor and ability to build structured insights
  • Excellent communication and executive presence
  • Storytelling that transforms data into selling narratives


Preferred Experience


  • Experience in frozen or high-velocity CPG categories
  • Prior work with national retailers and major distributors
  • Startup or high-growth CPG environment

title: SAP S/4 HANA Application Architect - Product Management (Arquitecto de aplicaciones SAP S/4 HANA - Gestión de productos) - End-user Support/Consultant
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


Primary Job Purpose

Responsible to support and assist in the design and implementation of the Supply Chain Operations template including configurations and determining the best ways to use S/4 HANA by merging business and IT needs and focusing on utilizing the system for the greatest efficiency and utilization.


Work very closely with Lead Solution Architect – Sales & Operations to meet SAP implementation deliverables.


Key Position Accountabilities

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP MM (Materials Management) and Variant Configuration related system configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Lead and Support the Product Management Area in the SAP implementation project from solution and architecture perspective and ensure timely completion of related project activities with key focus on quality.
  • Facilitate and support Solution Architects, Workstream managers & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Material master data processes and integration of same with sales and Customer Service, finance & Operation workstreams.
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Analyse, create and document business processes during the project implementation.
  • Support larger project team during configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and up-grade phases.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / Master's degree in Business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support project experience in the area of material master data, data modelling, data governance in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects with knowledge of integration across financial and logistics processes in SAP as a lead subject matter expert.
  • Hands on experience defining various types of Material master, Variant Configuration, Bill of Materials, Class & Characteristics and Object dependencies.
  • Should have demonstrated hands-on experience in delivery of large, complex, global engagements involving multi-currency, multi-location, multi-organization complexities.
  • Should have solution design capabilities to reengineer business processes, sound knowledge of process modelling, ERP and packaged application fit/gap analysis, addressing critical business challenges typical to the industry or regional process nuances.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices and knowledge in Master data, MM module, their integrations & technology.
  • Ability to learn new tasks quickly; demonstrate flexibility when presented with change.
  • Lead and support a team environment.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP MM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform


WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in US/APC time zone as well for the need basis.

title: Business Development Manager – Advertisers & Agencies (LATAM)
description:
Company Description

Orange Storm is a leading venture-backed AdTech and AI SaaS company with dual headquarters in California, USA, and Barcelona, Spain. Our integrated ecosystem includes a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and an AI-driven analytics platform, empowering publishers and advertisers to make smarter decisions and drive revenue growth. Our global and diverse team thrives in a culture of trust, ownership, and continuous learning. We are looking for a proactive Business Development Manager based in Argentina to help expand our partnerships with advertisers and performance agencies in LATAM.

This role focuses on building a strong pipeline through outbound outreach and industry networking. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys identifying new partners, starting conversations, and turning connections into long-term collaborations.

You will work closely with internal teams to introduce our advertising solutions and onboard new partners.


Responsibilities

  • Proactively identify and connect with advertisers and performance agencies in LATAM
  • Conduct daily outreach through LinkedIn, email, Telegram communities, and other networking channels
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline
  • Schedule meetings and introduce our advertising solutions to potential partners
  • Develop relationships with media buyers, agencies, and advertiser teams
  • Support the onboarding process for new partners and coordinate internally with operations teams
  • Maintain long-term relationships and help grow advertiser spend over time
  • Explore creative ways to find partners, including industry communities, social platforms, and events

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in AdTech, performance marketing, affiliate marketing, or digital advertising
  • Strong outbound sales or partnership development mindset
  • Comfortable doing high-volume outreach and networking
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Based in Argentina
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment

Nice to Have

  • Spanish + Portuguese bilingual
  • Experience working with advertisers or performance agencies
  • Existing connections with LATAM advertisers or media buying teams
  • Russian language skills are a plus

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + performance-based commission
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Opportunity to grow with an international AdTech company
  • Direct exposure to the global digital advertising ecosystem

Ideal Candidate

Someone who:

  • Enjoys building pipeline and starting new conversations
  • Is creative in finding potential partners and opportunities
  • Is proactive and comfortable reaching out to new people
  • Wants to grow in the AdTech and performance marketing industry

description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


Primary Job Purpose

Responsible to support and assist in the design and implementation of the Supply Chain Operations template including configurations and determining the best ways to use S/4 HANA by merging business and IT needs and focusing on utilizing the system for the greatest efficiency and utilization.


Work very closely with Lead Solution Architect – Sales & Operations to meet SAP implementation deliverables.


Key Position Accountabilities

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP MM (Materials Management) and Variant Configuration related system configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Lead and Support the Product Management Area in the SAP implementation project from solution and architecture perspective and ensure timely completion of related project activities with key focus on quality.
  • Facilitate and support Solution Architects, Workstream managers & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Material master data processes and integration of same with sales and Customer Service, finance & Operation workstreams.
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Analyse, create and document business processes during the project implementation.
  • Support larger project team during configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and up-grade phases.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / Master's degree in Business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support project experience in the area of material master data, data modelling, data governance in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects with knowledge of integration across financial and logistics processes in SAP as a lead subject matter expert.
  • Hands on experience defining various types of Material master, Variant Configuration, Bill of Materials, Class & Characteristics and Object dependencies.
  • Should have demonstrated hands-on experience in delivery of large, complex, global engagements involving multi-currency, multi-location, multi-organization complexities.
  • Should have solution design capabilities to reengineer business processes, sound knowledge of process modelling, ERP and packaged application fit/gap analysis, addressing critical business challenges typical to the industry or regional process nuances.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices and knowledge in Master data, MM module, their integrations & technology.
  • Ability to learn new tasks quickly; demonstrate flexibility when presented with change.
  • Lead and support a team environment.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP MM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform


WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in US/APC time zone as well for the need basis.

description:

Orange Storm is a leading venture-backed AdTech and AI SaaS company with dual headquarters in California, USA, and Barcelona, Spain. Our integrated ecosystem includes a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and an AI-driven analytics platform, empowering publishers and advertisers to make smarter decisions and drive revenue growth. This role focuses on building a strong pipeline through outbound outreach and industry networking. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys identifying new partners, starting conversations, and turning connections into long-term collaborations.

You will work closely with internal teams to introduce our advertising solutions and onboard new partners.

  • Proactively identify and connect with advertisers and performance agencies in LATAM

  • Maintain long-term relationships and help grow advertiser spend over time
  • Explore creative ways to find partners, including industry communities, social platforms, and events

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in AdTech, performance marketing, affiliate marketing, or digital advertising
  • Strong outbound sales or partnership development mindset
  • Comfortable doing high-volume outreach and networking
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Based in Argentina
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment

Nice to Have

  • Spanish + Portuguese bilingual
  • Experience working with advertisers or performance agencies
  • Existing connections with LATAM advertisers or media buying teams
  • Russian language skills are a plus

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + performance-based commission
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Opportunity to grow with an international AdTech company
  • Direct exposure to the global digital advertising ecosystem

Ideal Candidate

Someone who:

  • Enjoys building pipeline and starting new conversations
  • Is creative in finding potential partners and opportunities
  • Is proactive and comfortable reaching out to new people
  • Wants to grow in the AdTech and performance marketing industry

title: Category Manager
description:
We are hiring an analytically elite Category Manager / Category Analyst to serve as the commercial intelligence engine for a fast-growing CPG brand scaling from. This role blends deep category analytics, trade optimization, and retail strategy with storytelling that drives better decisions — internally and with key partners.


You will transform complex datasets — syndicated data (SPINS, Nielsen, IRI), retailer portals (e.g., 84.51°), distributor reporting, and internal systems — into actionable insights that meaningfully improve velocity, trade efficiency, pricing, and distribution performance. This person is the strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, and Leadership.


Strategic Importance


  • As we scale nationally and deepen relationships with major retailers and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), this role is critical to commercial success by:
  • Elevating category insights as a competitive advantage
  • Strengthening sales pitches with data-backed stories that win distribution
  • Increasing promo ROI through rigorous trade and lift analysis
  • Driving cross-functional alignment on strategy via clear analytics + narratives
  • This role is not just about dashboards — it’s about impact and influence across the business.



Key Responsibilities


  • Syndicated Data + Retailer Insights
  • Own analysis of SPINS, Nielsen/IRI and retailer portal data to understand:
  • Category growth drivers
  • Competitor dynamics
  • Velocity and share trends
  • Translate data into retailer-specific insights for buyers and commercial teams.


Promotion & Trade Effectiveness


  • Measure incremental lift, promo effectiveness, and trade ROI.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to improve TPM discipline, promotional forecasting and post mortems.
  • Create frameworks to compare promo results vs. baseline and forecast.


Assortment, Pricing, and Space Strategy


  • Recommend SKU rationalization, pricing strategies, and assortment optimization.
  • Partner with Sales/Category buyers on planogram space recommendations.


Distributor & Retail Performance Tracking

Track performance across key channels and distributors (UNFI, KeHE, C&S, Dot), including:


  • Fill rates
  • Retail sell-through
  • Inventory health and void risk


Provide early-warning signals and corrective action recommendations.

Forecasting & Demand Planning Support


  • Improve forecast accuracy and alignment with Supply Chain and Finance.
  • Provide insights that enhance S&OP and promotional planning.


Cross-Functional Analytics & Reporting

Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards in Power BI / Tableau.


Provide cadence reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) tailored to:


  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations


Executive Storytelling & Data Communication


  • Translate analytics into structured business narratives that inform strategy and execution.
  • Support pitch materials, competitive heatmaps, and retailer presentations.


Required Experience & Skills


Experience


  • 3–8+ years in CPG analytics, category management, revenue management, or related retail strategy roles.


Proven track record with:


  • Syndicated data platforms (SPINS, Nielsen/IRI)
  • Retailer portals (84.51°, Luminate)
  • Commercial analytics in a growth CPG environment


Technical Skills


  • Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data transformations)
  • Power BI / Tableau dashboard creation
  • Familiarity with trade spend economics, TPM, and promotional lift frameworks


Capabilities


  • Strong analytical rigor and ability to build structured insights
  • Excellent communication and executive presence
  • Storytelling that transforms data into selling narratives


Preferred Experience


  • Experience in frozen or high-velocity CPG categories
  • Prior work with national retailers and major distributors
  • Startup or high-growth CPG environment

Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.

At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Coordenador(a) da Qualidade
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:


  • Atuar como guardião dos parâmetros de qualidade (ex: CI/TI, PPM, SAC), assegurando o cumprimento das especificações e a tratativa de desvios.
  • Liderar e validar a elaboração e revisão de procedimentos, métodos de análise (MA), formulários, instruções de trabalho e matriz de responsabilidades dos inspetores.
  • Coordenar as atividades de homologação de novos produtos e elaboração de relatórios técnicos.
  • Coordenar o cronograma de Auditorias Internas e Externas, acompanhar e direcionar o time e áreas de apoio.

  • Garantir a conformidade com as Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF), liderando auditorias internas e externas, pré-auditorias e gestão de registros.
  • Supervisionar a calibração dos equipamentos e a gestão da infraestrutura dos laboratórios de qualidade.
  • Analisar criticamente os resultados dos indicadores da área e liderar comitês de SAC, CI/TI e Qualidade.
  • Promover a efetividade das coletas de micro e atualização das grades de produto no ERP (SAP/Framework).
  • Liderar homologação de novos produtos – MSR/RSR.
  • Liderar treinamentos técnicos e apoiar a área de T&D na capacitação dos inspetores de qualidade.
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões operacionais, projetos, segurança, workstreams e gembas, atuando como termômetro do clima da operação e influenciador na tomada de decisão.
  • Ser responsável por Requisitos regulatório junto a Gestão da sua planta de atuação, garantindo a efetividade e conclusão dos prazos, planos de ação, atualização de normas, homologação de novos produtos, Plano mestre de validação junto as áreas, e apoio a área jurídica quando necessário.
  • Planejar férias, escalas e assegurar a gestão da equipe de qualidade em todas as frentes (atributos, variáveis, SAC e laboratório).
  • Ser um líder influenciador nas ações de SAC de sua categoria.
  • Administrar a equipe de trabalho, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho de alta motivação, energia e cooperação, orientando, treinando, acompanhando a atuação, avaliando o desempenho, dando feedback, divulgando, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir os procedimentos/normas relativos à empresa, processo de trabalho e aos sistemas de gestão implementados.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.


Requisitos:


  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Química, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Registro ativo no CRQ ou CRF.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA.
  • Domínio Multiplicador em: Indicadores de Qualidade (PPM, CI/TI, Retido, Rejeitado, SAC), em Ferramentas de controle da qualidade (ex PDCA, 5W2H, 5 porquês), em Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF), em Gestão de laboratórios e calibração de equipamentos, em Elaboração e revisão de procedimentos, MA’s e IT’s.
  • Domínio em Pacote Office, principalmente Excel.
  • Desejável pós-graduação em Engenharia da Qualidade, Gestão de Projetos, Engenharia de Processos, Assuntos Regulatórios, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável Green Belt e Metodologia Lean.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas estatísticas, em sistemas ERP (Ex: SAP), Workflow e gestão documental será considerado um diferencial.
  • Inglês intermediário será considerado um diferencial.


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Director of Marketing | Hotel Technology Experience Required
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next-generation, AI-native platform for the hospitality industry. Looking for a Director of Marketing who understands hotels, understands technology, and knows how to turn that knowledge into real growth.


This role is ideal for someone who has marketed to hotel decision-makers before and enjoys building campaigns, writing compelling content, and generating measurable demand.


About the Role

We’re building something special for the hotel industry, and we’re looking for a Director of Marketing who feels at home in the world of hotel technology.


If you’ve spent meaningful time marketing to hoteliers, understand how hotel decision-makers think, and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to create campaigns that drive pipeline, you’ll thrive in this role.


This is a hands-on, full-funnel leadership role responsible for building and scaling our marketing engine. You will oversee demand generation, product marketing, content creation, and go-to-market strategy while working closely with Sales to drive qualified leads and revenue growth.


The hospitality industry values clarity, trust, and solutions that make operations easier. We’re looking for someone who knows how to communicate exactly that.


What You’ll Be Doing

Develop a deep understanding of the hotel ecosystem, including independent hotels, management companies, and brand-affiliated properties.


Stay closely connected to the needs and priorities of hotel decision-makers such as:

  • General Managers
  • Directors of Sales and Marketing
  • Revenue Managers
  • Digital marketing leaders
  • IT leaders


Use these insights to shape messaging, positioning, and campaigns that resonate with hotel operators.


Owning the Marketing Engine

Build and manage the full marketing funnel—from awareness through lead generation, nurturing, and conversion to sales.


Key areas include:

  • Demand generation strategy
  • SEO and digital acquisition
  • Email and lifecycle marketing
  • Webinars and industry events
  • Campaign development and execution


Your goal is to ensure marketing consistently generates qualified pipeline for the sales team.


Leading Blog and Thought Leadership Strategy

Own and grow the company’s blog and thought leadership presence to establish authority in the hospitality technology space and drive inbound demand.


This includes:

  • Writing and overseeing blog content focused on hotel industry trends and insights
  • Creating thought leadership around topics like AI in hospitality, guest engagement, and direct booking strategies
  • Developing SEO-driven blog content that attracts hotel decision-makers researching solutions
  • Implement AI Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies to ensure the company and its content are discoverable through AI agents like Copilot, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging AI-driven discovery platforms.
  • Repurposing blog content into campaigns, LinkedIn posts, webinars, and sales materials


Creating Content That Speaks the Hotel Industry’s Language

Develop and oversee content that resonates with hospitality leaders, including:

  • Blog articles and thought leadership pieces
  • Industry guides and educational resources
  • Case studies and ROI stories
  • Campaign messaging and landing pages
  • Sales enablement materials


The goal is content that feels authentic, practical, and directly relevant to hotel operators , while positioning the company as a trusted voice in hospitality technology.


Becoming Deeply Fluent in the Product

You will develop strong product knowledge and become fluent in how the platform works.


This includes understanding:

  • How the product integrates into the hotel technology stack
  • The operational problems it solves for hotel teams
  • The value it creates for revenue growth and guest engagement


This fluency will help shape messaging, positioning, and product launches.


Partnering Closely with Sales

Marketing and sales alignment is critical in this role.


You will work closely with the sales team to:

  • Align on pipeline and growth targets
  • Develop campaigns that generate qualified opportunities
  • Support sales with content, messaging, and materials
  • Continuously improve lead quality and funnel performance


Using Data to Drive Decisions

Track performance across the funnel and continuously improve marketing efficiency.


You will analyze:

  • Lead generation performance
  • Campaign ROI
  • Funnel conversion metrics
  • Customer acquisition trends


Marketing should be measurable, predictable, and scalable.


Success in This Role

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to build a scalable marketing engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline.


Key outcomes include:

  • Growth in marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline
  • Consistent generation of qualified leads for the sales team
  • Increased inbound demand through SEO, blog content, and thought leadership
  • Strong campaign performance across webinars, events, and digital channels
  • Clear and compelling positioning that resonates with hotel decision-makers


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience marketing to hotels or within the hospitality technology ecosystem
  • Experience in B2B SaaS marketing and demand generation
  • Proven ability to generate qualified pipeline and measurable revenue impact
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, including blogs and thought leadership content
  • Ability to translate complex technology into clear, compelling messaging
  • Comfort operating both strategically and hands-on
  • Experience collaborating closely with sales teams in a pipeline-driven environment
  • Interest in AI-driven platforms, automation, and emerging technology transforming hospitality


Experience at or working with hospitality technology platforms such as hotel CRM, guest engagement, marketing automation, revenue management, or hotel operations platforms is highly valued.


Why You Might Love This Role

You enjoy understanding how an industry works and building marketing that speaks directly to it.


You like owning the entire marketing engine , not just one channel.


You enjoy turning insight, content, and campaigns into measurable growth.


You want to help shape how the hospitality industry adopts the next generation of technology.


Why Join Us

You’ll be joining a modern AI-native product company that is helping reshape how hotels understand their guests, grow direct bookings, and operate more intelligently.


This is a rare opportunity to help introduce AI-powered guest engagement and marketing technology to the hospitality industry while building a marketing engine that drives real growth.


Your work will directly influence:

  • How the industry understands our product
  • How we position ourselves in the market
  • How we generate scalable demand


You won’t just run campaigns—you’ll help define how a new category of hospitality technology is introduced to the market and adopted by hotel leaders around the world.


If you’re energized by hospitality, great products, and building a marketing engine that truly moves the needle, we’d love to meet you.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About Mosaic Puzzles

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.


We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.


Check our website for more information:


Position Overview

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.


This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.


You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.


Key Responsibilities


Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.



Content & Brand Communication

  • Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
  • Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
  • Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.


Digital Marketing & Analytics

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
  • Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  • Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
  • Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.


Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
  • Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing analytics and performance tracking .
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
  • Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
  • Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
  • Knowledge of SEO is a plus.


How to Apply

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨
