title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.


Required Skills & Experience


• 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness.

• Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%).

• Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience

• Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms.

• Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable).

• Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.


Job Description


We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).


Day to Day

• Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support.

• Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines.

• Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

• Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution.

• Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar; validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors.

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness.

• Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: Analista de sistemas
description:
Você é um profissional dinâmico e com espírito de crescimento? Então essa oportunidade é para você! 

Quem somos?


A Komanda F5 é uma empresa inovadora que vem ajudando negócios a digitalizar seus processos de vendas desde 2012. O que você fará?

  • Negociações e Correspondência Comercial : Interagir com clientes para promover nossos serviços e soluções.
  • Expansão de Assinaturas : Gerenciar e expandir as assinaturas de nossos clientes.
  • Gestão do CRM Kommo : Trabalhar com nossa plataforma para garantir que os clientes aproveitem ao máximo suas funcionalidades.
  • Documentação : Elaborar contratos e emitir notas fiscais.
  • Suporte ao Cliente : Ajudar nossos clientes com dúvidas e garantir uma experiência excelente.
  • Configuração de Contas : Ajustar as contas de nossos clientes para atender às suas necessidades específicas.


Quem buscamos?

  • Inglês intermediário (nível B1 ou superior).
  • Experiência de pelo menos 1 ano em vendas B2B .
  • Proficiência em português e inglês (avançado).
  • Perfil orientado a resultados, disciplinado e cheio de energia.
  • Habilidade para aprender de forma autônoma, grande capacidade de comunicação e motivação para buscar sempre o melhor desempenho.


O que oferecemos?

  • Treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades;
  • Salário U$600 USD + Comissão;
  • Trabalhar apenas com leads inbound ;
  • Acesso a um sistema de CRM fácil de usar e de alto impacto;
  • Um time motivado e sempre disposto a crescer junto com você;
  • Horário de segunda a sexta-feira, das 09:00 às 18:00.
  • 100% Remoto 


Se você é motivado, quer trabalhar em uma empresa global e está pronto para um desafio que pode gerar ótimos resultados financeiros e de crescimento profissional, venha fazer parte da Komanda F5 !

title: Product Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.


About us:


Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.


But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

title: Consultor(a) SAP SuccessFactors Compensation SR
description:
Somos a SEIDOR, multinacional de tecnologia e inovação, que oferece um portfólio completo de soluções e serviços para promover a competitividade e a transformação das organizações. São mais de 40 anos acreditando na tecnologia , com 85 escritórios e uma equipe de mais de 7.500 profissionais na Europa, América Latina, Estados Unidos, África, Oriente Médio e Ásia.


Somos parceiros platinum da SAP e temos mais de 8.500 clientes . Nosso portfólio completo é voltado para empresas grandes, médias e em crescimento. Na SEIDOR acreditamos que, para enfrentar os novos desafios do mundo digital, devemos ter os melhores aliados, as tecnologias líderes de mercado e, acima de tudo, as melhores pessoas.


Nós acreditamos no valor das pessoas . Buscamos constantemente atrair e reter talentos, investindo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e oferecendo oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Nosso time é composto por profissionais colaborativos, autônomos e ágeis que juntos formam um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, dinâmico e sem discriminação, respeitando as diferenças que nos tornam mais humanos.


✨ Venha fazer parte desse novo projeto! ✨

Tem os requisitos abaixo? Então essas vagas são para você ! ✨

  • Consultor(a) SAP SuccessFactors Compensation SR


Sobre a oportunidade:

  • Atuar em projetos de implementação e/ou rollout do módulo Compensation do SAP SuccessFactors, do Blueprint ao Go-live/Hypercare.
  • Conduzir workshops de levantamento de requisitos (AS-IS/TO-BE) com RH e TI para desenho do processo de recrutamento e seleção.
  • Elaborar desenho de solução e documentação funcional (ex.: mapeamentos, decisões, regras e fluxos do processo seletivo).
  • Configurar e parametrizar o Recruiting conforme escopo do projeto, incluindo: job requisitions e templates de requisição; processos seletivos, estágios e status; formulários de candidatura e campos customizados; workflows de aprovação, e-mails e notificações; regras de elegibilidade e roteamento de candidatos; Apoiar o desenho e execução de testes (SIT/UAT), incluindo preparação de cenários, suporte a usuários-chave, registro de evidências e correção de defeitos.
  • Apoiar cutover e atividades de go-live, garantindo prontidão do processo (configurações finais, validações e comunicações de mudança).
  • Realizar troubleshooting de processos, regras e possíveis impactos de integrações relacionadas ao Recruiting, em conjunto com times técnicos quando necessário; Produzir e manter documentação do projeto (roteiros de teste, guias rápidos, materiais de treinamento e apoio à adoção).
  • Orientar e treinar key users, recrutadores e gestores durante o projeto, apoiando a gestão de mudanças.
  • Interagir com áreas de negócio, TI e fornecedores para alinhar dependências, riscos e decisões de desenho.
  • Garantir aderência do Recruiting às políticas e processos de RH do cliente e às melhores práticas SAP.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP SuccessFactors – Compensation, com atuação relevante em projetos de implementação/rollout;
  • Conhecimento sólido em configuração do Compensation: planos (merit, bonus, LTIP), eligibility, guidelines, proration, workflows e regras de cálculo;
  • Experiência com levantamento de requisitos e desenho de processos de compensação e remuneração;
  • Vivência com testes (SIT/UAT), suporte a usuários-chave e tratativa de defeitos;
  • Familiaridade (ao menos funcional) com integrações do SuccessFactors (ex.: Integration Center, APIs, conectores) e capacidade de apoiar análise de falhas;
  • Capacidade de elaborar documentação funcional/técnica (solution design, mapeamentos, roteiros e evidências);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, organização e trabalho em equipe.


Desejável:

  • Certificação SAP SuccessFactors Compensation;
  • Conhecimento em outros módulos (ex.: Employee Central, PMGM, Variable Pay);
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado;
  • Participação em projetos de integração Compensation × PMGM e Compensation × EC;
  • Experiência com LTIP (Long Term Incentive Plans) e planos complexos de remuneração variável;
  • Habilidade para conduzir workshops e ministrar treinamentos (funcionais e para usuários).

Junte-se a nós e ajude-nos a humanizar o mundo através da tecnologia!

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
Location / Remote: Remote -- Candidates who reside outside the United States will be considered.


Time Zone: Must be willing to work Eastern Timezone Hours


Communication : Only candidates with professional-level English proficiency will be considered.


Employment Type: 12-month contract (W-2, C2C).


Compensation: Up to 33 U.S. dollars per hour (depending on experience).


This role focuses on designing and delivering enterprise-grade AI-driven automation solutions. The Agentic Solutions Architect will play a hands-on role in architecting secure, scalable, and production-ready intelligent automation systems that integrate AI agents, enterprise platforms, APIs, and data systems. Success in this position requires deep technical expertise, a strong understanding of automation architecture, and the ability to guide teams in implementing innovative AI solutions.


Responsibilities:


  • Architect enterprise-grade intelligent automation solutions integrating AI agents, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
  • Design and implement multi-step workflows involving AI agents, RPA bots, and enterprise applications.
  • Establish architecture patterns for orchestration, exception handling, approvals, and auditability.
  • Leverage Microsoft Copilot and Power Platform AI tools, including Copilot Studio and Power Automate.
  • Architect secure integrations between AI agents, automation platforms, and enterprise data systems, particularly Databricks.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams.
  • Evaluate emerging agent technologies and recommend best practices for adoption.
  • Develop repeatable architecture standards, patterns, and governance practices for AI automation.


Required Skills:


  • 7+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise automation architecture, or similar roles.
  • Proven experience delivering AI-driven or intelligent automation solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Copilot / Power Platform AI capabilities (e.g., Copilot Studio, Power Automate).
  • Familiarity with Azure AI services or Microsoft AI Foundry.
  • Strong experience designing API-driven integrations and distributed automation architectures.
  • Experience integrating automation solutions with enterprise data platforms, with a preference for Databricks.
  • Ability to design secure, scalable, and production-ready AI automation solutions.


Preferred Skills:


  • Experience with enterprise RPA platforms such as UiPath or similar.
  • Experience designing multi-agent workflows or human-in-the-loop automation systems.
  • Experience supporting enterprise Automation or AI Centers of Excellence.
  • Expertise in establishing architecture standards, reusable components, and automation governance frameworks.

BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Part-time | Full-time | REMOTE

Requirements

  • Experience in localization operations, marketing, or PR; experience in offline event execution and logistics coordination is preferred.
  • Familiar with the culture, social platforms, and media ecosystem of the local language region; capable of PR content writing and market promotion optimization; understands local logistics and business coordination processes.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to efficiently connect headquarters, local media, partners, and clients.
  • Proactive thinking and execution ability, with strong delivery, business negotiation skills, and responsibility.

title: Product Owner (PO) - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Product Owner (PO) - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

  • Atuar como PO no dia a dia do time, garantindo clareza das demandas e sua correta priorização.
  • Conduzir e participar de cerimônias ágeis: refinamento, planning, daily, review e retrospectiva.
  • Escrever e detalhar user stories, critérios de aceite e casos de uso.
  • Acompanhar o andamento das entregas, riscos, impedimentos e evolução dos sprints.
  • Garantir comunicação contínua com o PM, trazendo visibilidade sobre status, decisões, gaps e eventos relevantes.
  • Apoiar na gestão e organização do backlog, mantendo-o atualizado, coerente e priorizado conforme estratégia.
  • Coordenar ou apoiar atividades relacionadas ao desenvolvimento do produto, incluindo alinhamentos técnicos e operacionais.
  • Monitorar métricas do time (velocity, burndown, lead time, capacity etc.) e reportar andamento de sprints.
  • Apoiar estruturação das user stories da equipe tendo em vista o roadmap do projeto.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou função equivalente em equipes ágeis.
  • Sólida prática em escrita de user stories, definição de critérios de aceite e refinamento técnico-funcional.
  • Conhecimento e prática de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara, tanto com áreas técnicas quanto de negócio.
  • Vivência em projetos de produtos digitais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes financeiros ou projetos de alto rigor regulatório.
  • Familiaridade com squads multidisciplinares e produtos em construção.
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas operacionais, propor soluções e apoiar decisões rápidas.
  • Vivência em projetos de integração com parceiros


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Power BI Administrator
description:
Responsibilities:


Power BI Administration

  • Manage Power BI Service: workspaces, datasets, dataflows, gateways, and capacity settings.
  • Administer and optimize Power BI Premium / PPU capacities.

Monitoring & Optimization

  • Monitor environmental health, performance, and audit logs.
  • Use administration APIs and Microsoft 365 tools for automation and reporting.

  • Strong knowledge of Power BI Desktop, DAX, semantic models, and data modeling.
  • Experience with Azure (Azure AD, Synapse, Fabric, etc.).
  • Experience with PowerShell, Power BI REST APIs, and automation.
  • Understanding governance, security, and compliance in enterprise analytics.
  • Knowledge of SQL, data warehousing, ETL, and pipelines/dataflows

title: SAP Specialist
description:
SAP S/4HANA FICO AMS Consultant

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide L2/L3 production support for SAP S/4HANA Finance (FICO) modules.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets using ITSM tools such as ServiceNow.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent solutions for recurring system issues.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial closing activities with finance teams.
  • Handle critical finance incidents and communicate updates to business and IT stakeholders.
  • Support and troubleshoot SAP FI modules including:
  • General Ledger (FI-GL)
  • Accounts Payable (FI-AP)
  • Accounts Receivable (FI-AR)
  • Asset Accounting (FI-AA)
  • Bank Accounting and Electronic Bank Statements
  • Provide support for Controlling (CO) processes during closing cycles including:
  • Material Ledger
  • Cost Center Accounting
  • Profit Center Accounting
  • Allocations and settlements
  • Analyze integration issues between finance and logistics processes such as FI-MM and FI-SD integrations.
  • Deliver minor system enhancements and configuration updates within the AMS support scope.
  • Prepare functional documentation, test cases, and support user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Participate in change management and release processes.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation aligned with audit and compliance standards.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 7–10 years of experience in SAP FICO consulting or application support.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance modules.
  • Proven experience in Application Management Support (AMS) or production support environments.
  • Solid knowledge of FI modules including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, and Bank Accounting.
  • Working knowledge of SAP CO processes, especially Material Ledger and month-end close activities.
  • Experience handling incident management, problem management, and service requests.
  • Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow.
  • Understanding of Brazil localization, taxes, and statutory financial requirements is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field.
  • SAP S/4HANA Finance certification is a plus.

title: Business Development Manager – Advertisers & Agencies (LATAM)
description:
Company Description

Orange Storm is a leading venture-backed AdTech and AI SaaS company with dual headquarters in California, USA, and Barcelona, Spain. Our integrated ecosystem includes a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and an AI-driven analytics platform, empowering publishers and advertisers to make smarter decisions and drive revenue growth. Our global and diverse team thrives in a culture of trust, ownership, and continuous learning. We prioritize collaboration, agile execution, and innovation to deliver scalable, high-performance technologies that adapt to the dynamic AdTech industry.


Role Description

We are looking for a proactive Business Development Manager based in Argentina to help expand our partnerships with advertisers and performance agencies in LATAM.

This role focuses on building a strong pipeline through outbound outreach and industry networking. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys identifying new partners, starting conversations, and turning connections into long-term collaborations.

You will work closely with internal teams to introduce our advertising solutions and onboard new partners.


Responsibilities

  • Proactively identify and connect with advertisers and performance agencies in LATAM
  • Conduct daily outreach through LinkedIn, email, Telegram communities, and other networking channels
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline
  • Schedule meetings and introduce our advertising solutions to potential partners
  • Develop relationships with media buyers, agencies, and advertiser teams
  • Support the onboarding process for new partners and coordinate internally with operations teams
  • Maintain long-term relationships and help grow advertiser spend over time
  • Explore creative ways to find partners, including industry communities, social platforms, and events

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in AdTech, performance marketing, affiliate marketing, or digital advertising
  • Strong outbound sales or partnership development mindset
  • Comfortable doing high-volume outreach and networking
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Based in Argentina
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment

Nice to Have

  • Spanish + Portuguese bilingual
  • Experience working with advertisers or performance agencies
  • Existing connections with LATAM advertisers or media buying teams
  • Russian language skills are a plus

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + performance-based commission
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Opportunity to grow with an international AdTech company
  • Direct exposure to the global digital advertising ecosystem

Ideal Candidate

Someone who:

  • Enjoys building pipeline and starting new conversations
  • Is creative in finding potential partners and opportunities
  • Is proactive and comfortable reaching out to new people
  • Wants to grow in the AdTech and performance marketing industry

title: Marketing Specialist
description:

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.

title: Analista de Growth Pleno — Jornada do Cliente & Conversão (ChatBot WhatsApp)
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ


Remoto


A ConCrédito é uma das maiores correspondentes bancárias do Brasil, especializada em crédito consignado nas modalidades CLT, INSS e FGTS. Com mais de 300 mil clientes atendidos via WhatsApp, a ConCrédito preza pelo bom atendimento e pela experiência do cliente, comprovados pelas mais de 21 mil avaliações positivas no Google Meu Negócio.


O Papel

O Analista de Growth Pleno será o principal responsável pela jornada do cliente no chatbot do WhatsApp, o maior canal de aquisição e relacionamento da empresa. A missão é clara: reduzir atrito, combater o abandono e maximizar o Lifetime Value (LTV) da base de leads e clientes.


Responsabilidades

  • Mapear e otimizar o funil conversacional de ponta a ponta, identificando gargalos nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups e arquitetura dos fluxos.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios e campanhas de reengajamento.
  • Auxiliar na construção de dashboards de acompanhamento da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados (Snowflake, Power BI).
  • Refinar clusters de audiência para personalização em escala.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com os times de Marketing, Vendas, BI e Produto/Tech.


KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Capacidade técnica de uso ou criação de agentes de IA, independentemente da ferramenta ou framework (Claude, Manus, Antigravity…).
  • Experiência sólida como Analista de Growth, CRO, Lifecycle Marketing, CRM ou Produto, com foco em conversão.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada: métricas de funil, análise de cohort, LTV e CAC.
  • Vivência prática com otimização de chatbots, automação de mensagens e WhatsApp API oficial.
  • Domínio de frameworks de growth hacking e testes A/B.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Boa comunicação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócios.


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, mercado de crédito ou operações B2C com alto volume de leads.
  • Conhecimento na plataforma ColmeIA ou chats conversacionais similares.
  • Habilidades em SQL e ferramentas como Metabase ou Supabase.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada à personalização de fluxos conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em automação com N8N.


Essa vaga NÃO é para você se:

  • Você é mais executor do que estrategista e não tem experiência otimizando funis de conversão.
  • Sua experiência está focada em social media, branding ou marketing de conteúdo.
  • Você trabalha apenas com análise de dados, sem transformar insights em ações práticas.
  • Sua atuação em growth é mais teórica do que prática (cursos, conceitos, pouca execução real).
  • Você nunca lidou com alto volume de leads ou operações em escala.
  • Seu foco é apenas aquisição (tráfego pago) e não conversão ao longo da jornada.
  • Você não tem experiência com chatbots, automação de mensagens ou fluxos conversacionais.
  • Você precisa de direcionamento constante e não tem autonomia para testar, iterar e tomar decisões.

title: Product Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.


About us:


Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.


But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About Mosaic Puzzles

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.


We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.


Check our website for more information:


Position Overview

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.


This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.


You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.


Key Responsibilities


Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.



Content & Brand Communication

  • Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
  • Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
  • Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.


Digital Marketing & Analytics

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
  • Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  • Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
  • Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.


Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
  • Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing analytics and performance tracking .
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
  • Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
  • Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
  • Knowledge of SEO is a plus.


How to Apply

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

description:
We are looking for a highly skilled SAP SD Consultant with strong expertise in SAP ECC environments, business process analysis, and cross‑functional collaboration. The ideal candidate must be bilingual in English, possess hands‑on experience across the full lifecycle of SAP implementations, and be capable of supporting and optimizing Order‑to‑Cash (OTC) processes in a dynamic, global environment.


Key Responsibilities

SAP Functional Expertise

  • Participate in at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation (preferably in a business-facing role).

  • Initial assessment
  • Determining need for internal/external assistance
  • Following standard procedures for cross-team collaboration

Systems Support & Testing

  • Lead and participate in integrated system testing ensuring business requirements are met.
  • Conduct and coordinate user training, documentation, and validation activities.
  • Ensure high-quality procedures, processes, and guidelines across deliverables.

Project & Work Management

  • Assist reporting managers with work prioritization and status updates in the Work Request Database.
  • Support development, enhancement, and production support efforts across business-critical SAP functions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

title: Business Development Manager/Director
description:
PingPong is on a mission to digitize trade, simplifying global growth for businesses. With $300B+ in payments processed, we're one of the world’s leading cross-border platforms – and we’re just getting started.

PingPong currently has 38 offices in 15 countries and over 1,500 employees. Our international presence helps businesses solve complex payment needs in every major economy across all time zones.


Now, we're scaling and looking for a BD Manager/Director to own the strategy, pipeline, and partnerships that will power our next phase of growth.


WHAT’S THE CHALLENGE?


You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You’ll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You’ve got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.


WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH


You’ll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You’ll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING


  • Build and execute our BD strategy across the LATAM with a focus on financial institutions, platforms and enterprise clients.
  • Maintain a high-quality pipeline across identified target verticals, focusing on high-impact deals, and think through supporting business development strategies.
  • Own the full sales cycle for closing new partners – from sourcing and qualification to leading the definition of the solution for the partner and negotiating the commercials, all the way through to go-live.
  • Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
  • Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
  • Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
  • Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the LATAM market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
  • Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.
  • Be the voice of the UK market internally – and help drive what comes next.


WHAT YOU BRING


  • Track record in BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales in fintech or financial services:
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions or regulated entities
  • Fluency in the world of payments, FX, embedded finance, or APIs.
  • Strategic thinker, hands-on doer, data-driven operator.
  • Able to speak the language of product, compliance, and commercial teams.


WHO YOU ARE


  • Educated with a relevant degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
  • Customer-focused, you can’t imagine working in any other way, and it’s the only way to achieve our goals.
  • Equally at home in both strategic planning and hands-on execution, ideally with experience in start-up/scale-up as well as larger organisations.
  • Ability to drill down, persistent and never-give-up spirit.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute high-impact business development strategies.
  • Strong consultative sales approach and experience negotiating with enterprise C-level executives.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills – able to influence internal and external stakeholders


PingPong is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity.

  • We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment.

title: Analista Pleno de IAM
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista Pleno de IAM (gestão de identidade e acesso)



Resumo:

Estamos buscando um Analista Pleno de IAM experiente para se juntar à nossa equipe de cibersegurança. Este profissional será responsável por criar processos, configurar ferramentas e aprimorar os assuntos de IAM de forma global.

O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outras frentes de segurança, infraestrutura, sistemas e equipes de negócios, avaliando as melhorias e implementações necessárias para a eficácia do Programa de IAM.



Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter processos de gestão de identidades e acessos, incluindo provisionamento, revogação e revisão periódica de privilégios;
  • Administrar e implementar ferramentas relacionadas à IAM garantindo funcionamento, confiabilidade e atendendo aos requisitos de segurança;
  • Criar, revisar e otimizar regras, perfis, grupos e políticas de acesso, assegurando a aplicação de princípio de privilégio mínimo e SoD (Segregação de Funções), para ambientes on prem e cloud;
  • Auxiliar na estratégia para integração de sistemas e aplicações às plataformas de IAM;
  • Colaborar com outros times para mapear processos de acesso, identificar riscos e sugerir implementações ou automações de controles;
  • Apoiar times internos na compreensão das práticas de gestão de identidades, acessos e requisitos de segurança relacionados;
  • Suportar processos de auditorias.



Requisitos Técnicos e Experiência:

  • Experiência de ao menos 3 anos atuando diretamente com temas ligados à IAM;
  • Formação Superior em Tecnologia da Informação/Segurança da Informação;
  • Conhecimento em temas como AD/Entra ID, LDAP, SAML, Oauth, SSO, MFA, PAM, SoD, RBAC, princípio de menor privilégio e revisão de acessos;
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Defender for Identity, e demais ferramentas de IAM para ambientes híbridos e multicloud (On Prem, Azure, AWS, GCP);
  • Fluência em inglês;

title: Performance Optimization Manager (Paid Social)
description:
AI Digital is a leading end-to-end programmatic agency empowering brands and agencies with transparent, unbiased, AI-enhanced media solutions. Founded in 2018, our global team of over 450 specialists connects clients to audiences through a unique blend of human expertise and advanced technology. We partner with all major advertising platforms to deliver measurable results that align with your business objectives and brand KPIs.   • Execute and optimize social campaigns across various platforms, such as Meta, Linkedin, and more with a focus on achieving media or performance KPIs.

title: Performance Marketing Analyst
description:

title: Marketing & Website Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Job Title: Marketing & Website Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)

Company : Elevated Tahoe Properties

Location : Remote


About Us

Elevated Tahoe Properties manages high-touch short-term rental and property portfolios focused on guest experience, operational excellence, and high-performing marketing that drives direct bookings. We’re hiring a proactive, creative, and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support our website, digital marketing, social media, and lead generation efforts.

Our Company Culture:

  • We are a fun, young company growing quickly
  • We value open communication and adding in humor whenever possible
  • Our team is self driven and empowered to handle their own responsibilities without being micromanaged
  • We inspire each other to become the best version of ourselves we can possibly become. 
  • We lead by example and use positive reinforcement to inspire others to strive for personal and professional greatness.

Role Summary

You will be responsible for helping us grow our online presence and increase direct vacation rental bookings through website updates, landing page creation, lead capture strategy, email marketing, and social media content support. This role requires strong design instincts, attention to detail, marketing experience, and a solid understanding of WordPress, Elementor, and basic website coding.


Key Responsibilities


  • Manage and update our WordPress website using Elementor
  • Build and optimize landing pages designed to drive bookings and capture leads
  • Improve website layout, visuals, and user experience to support conversion goals
  • Help increase traffic to the website through organic and campaign-based marketing efforts
  • Develop compelling, conversion-focused copywriting that incorporates SEO best practices for all web and marketing assets
  • Edit and prepare social media content including short-form video, photos, graphics, and captions
  • Schedule and publish social media posts across relevant platforms
  • Monitor inbound leads and help organize follow-up and lead nurturing workflows
  • Create and manage nurture email campaigns for existing guests, past guests, and new leads
  • Support list building, audience segmentation, and email campaign improvements
  • Assist with marketing asset creation for promotions, campaigns, and seasonal offers
  • Maintain brand consistency across website pages, email marketing, and social media content
  • Collaborate with leadership on ideas to improve direct bookings, lead generation, and guest engagement

Qualifications


  • Proven experience in digital marketing, website management, or lead generation
  • Strong hands-on experience with WordPress and Elementor
  • Strong design skills with an eye for clean, polished, high-converting content
  • Experience editing social media video and photo content
  • Experience with email marketing platforms and nurture campaigns
  • Comfortable creating landing pages and understanding basic conversion strategy
  • Decent to strong website coding basics, including familiarity with HTML/CSS and light troubleshooting
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple moving pieces
  • Able to work independently, take initiative, and bring creative solutions to the table
  • Familiarity with Asana or similar project management tools

Non‑Negotiable Requirements

  • Reliable backup power (UPS or generator) to prevent downtime during outages
  • Dual monitors for efficient multitasking
  • Backup internet (secondary wired connection or mobile hotspot) with stable speeds
  • Quiet, dedicated workspace and dependable computer 

Preferred

  • Experience with the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) or similar creative tools
  • Strong video editing proficiency for creating engaging short-form content
  • Deep understanding of social media marketing trends, algorithms, and best practices
  • Experience working with hospitality, vacation rentals, real estate, or travel brands

Required Days/Hours

  • Monday - Friday 8AM to 5PM Pacific Time (1 hour unpaid Lunch Break)


Compensation Target:

$950 per month + monthly KPI bonus / 40 hours per week — salary negotiable based on experience.

What We Offer

  • Remote role supporting a growing vacation rental and hospitality brand
  • Opportunity to directly impact bookings, lead generation, and brand growth
  • Creative, collaborative team environment with room to contribute ideas and improve systems


How to Apply (only email applications will be considered)


Email :

Subject : The Marketing & Website Coordinator Your Team Needs


Include:

  • Your Resume/CV
  • ONE OF (listed in order of preference):
  • A link to your personal portfolio website
  • A comprehensive PDF format portfolio document
  • At list of at least 5 links of design and marketing work you’ve completed
  • Pre-Screening Form:
  • Internet Speed Verification:

Note : Please only submit a screenshot of the speed test results.

  • DISC Assessment:

  Note : Please only submit a screenshot of the DISC assessment results graph.

  • A 2–3 minute video that includes:

-Brief intro and summary of your experience

-Why you’re the ideal candidate for this position

-Your top 3 skills that make you an excellent marketing and design coordinator


﻿Only applicants who follow these instructions exactly and demonstrate strong attention to detail will be considered.


Thank you and we look forward to working with you!


~ Elevated Tahoe Properties Team

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Native Teams is a global platform for work payments and employment. Beyond managing payroll, compliance, and taxes, we integrate financial tools to maximise the value of every work payment, worldwide.


We are expanding our global team and looking for a Business Development Manager to bring their wider knowledge and help us get our product and service more widely known and used.


In this role, you will play a key role in driving new business and revenue growth by managing the full sales cycle from outbound outreach to discovery, solution design, negotiation, and closing. You will work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs, educate them on Native Teams' solutions, and guide them through the decision-making and onboarding process. Your goal is to acquire new customers and expand revenue within assigned markets and ICPs.


Would you like to take on a new challenge in the field of sales in a successful, fast-growing global start-up?


Location: Remote

Salary range: Flexible


Key Responsibilities


Outbound & Pipeline Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage prospective clients through outbound outreach, networking, events, and other channels.
  • Execute outbound strategies tailored to defined ICPs and market segments.
  • Research accounts for understanding business context, hiring plans, and potential use cases.


Inbound Handling

  • Take qualified inbound requests and convert them into active opportunities.
  • Respond promptly and professionally in line with internal SLAs.
  • Run a structured qualification to assess fit and readiness.


Discovery & Consultative Selling

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls to understand client goals, blockers, compliance considerations, and service requirements.
  • Educate prospects on how Native Teams supports global employment, payroll, and work payments.
  • Present tailored solutions, product overviews, and value propositions to multiple stakeholders.


Solution Design & Pricing

  • Prepare proposals, pricing scenarios, and competitive a/b options in line with commercial guidelines.
  • Guide clients on hiring models (EoR, Contractor of Record, etc.) and explain operational processes.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure feasibility for legal, product, and finance-related questions.


Negotiation & Closing

  • Manage contract negotiations and commercial discussions through to signature.
  • Navigate procurement timelines, internal approvals, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Close new business and achieve monthly/quarterly revenue targets.


Pipeline Ownership & Forecasting

  • Maintain an up-to-date sales pipeline with accurate stage management and forecasting.
  • Log all activities, updates, and communication history in the CRM.
  • Prioritize high-impact opportunities while balancing follow-ups and nurturing.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and Product teams to ensure a smooth client transition post-close.
  • Relay client feedback to internal stakeholders to support product and process improvements.
  • Represent the sales voice in outbound campaigns, ICP targeting, and revenue initiatives.


Market Feedback & Learning

  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitive offerings, and compliance developments.
  • Share insights from the market to improve positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.



Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
  • Experience in outbound sales, B2B sales, or full-cycle sales roles.
  • Strong communication and client-facing presentation skills.
  • Confident running discovery calls, demos, and negotiations.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot) and sales outreach tools.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deals in parallel.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, work autonomously, and drive outcomes.
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.



Benefits


  • Dynamic and interesting work in an early-stage, funded startup.
  • Ability to influence the next stages of our growth.
  • Experience working in the ever-changing world of FinTech.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.
  • Flexible work environment.



Join our team at Native Teams, a fast-growing global start-up. We're looking for driven, passionate individuals to join us as we continue to expand our reach and impact.


At Native Teams, we pride ourselves on our dynamic and supportive work environment, where we encourage personal and professional growth. We believe in hiring talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, not only because we should do it but because fresh perspectives improve our team and our decisions. Our multicultural team is made up of young, energetic, and positive people who are passionate about what they do.


As part of our team, you’ll reflect the people we serve and will have the opportunity to work with thousands and impact millions of lives around the world.


If you're looking for a challenging and rewarding career and the chance to be part of a team that's making a real difference in the world, then we want to hear from you.


Apply now to join the Native Teams family and take the first step toward a brighter future!

title: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases
description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases


Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


About the Role


We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.


What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration


Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.x
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)


Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Integration Analyst

Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Integration Analyst , apoiando iniciativas estratégicas de integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir soluções utilizando .NET (C#) , aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura, SOLID e Design Patterns .
  • Criar, consumir e manter APIs REST , garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e performance.
  • Implementar e sustentar soluções em Azure , utilizando serviços como Azure Functions, App Services, Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault e Application Insights .
  • Trabalhar com integração de sistemas entre múltiplas plataformas , incluindo ambientes corporativos e parceiros externos.
  • Atuar com CI/CD , versionamento e automação utilizando GitHub e GitHub Actions .
  • Implementar e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Garantir segurança de APIs , utilizando padrões como OAuth2 e JWT .
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica clara e estruturada .
  • Colaborar com times técnicos internos, stakeholders de negócio e parceiros externos em um ambiente corporativo global.
  • Atuar em times Agile , participando de cerimônias Scrum e/ou SAFe.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos com desenvolvimento .NET (C#) .
  • Vivência prática com metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou SAFe).
  • Experiência comprovada com Azure Cloud , incluindo:
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure App Services
  • Azure Storage
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure Service Bus
  • Application Insights

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de QA com foco em garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções desenvolvidas pela Klavi. Essa pessoa atuará de forma colaborativa com os times de produto e engenharia, contribuindo para a definição de cenários de teste, automação de testes, identificação e prevenção de bugs em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas entregas atendam aos mais altos padrões de qualidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência para os usuários finais.


Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.
  • Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.
  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.


Salário

  • Regime: PJ
  • Salário: Competitivo
  • Nível: Especialista


Principais responsabilidades

  • Investigar e diagnosticar falhas, identificando a causa raiz de bugs e inconsistências no sistema.

  • Implementar testes automatizados para garantir a cobertura e a confiabilidade de novas funcionalidades.
  • Validar o estado do sistema antes de implantações, garantindo que todos os ambientes estejam estáveis e prontos para release.

title: Business Development Manager (FX/CFD)
description:
D Prime is a globally recognized online broker, empowering professional investors with access to multi-asset CFD trading across global markets. Key Responsibilities


  • Develop new and existing markets and client base, promote our trading solutions
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, IBs, and affiliates

  • Proven experience in Business Development / Sales within a CFD / Forex Brokerage

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Experience working with CRM systems and managing sales pipelines
  • Existing network of traders, IBs, or affiliates is a strong advantage
  • Ability to analyze market trends and identify revenue opportunities
  • Target-driven mindset with experience working toward KPIs and revenue goals

  • Career progression within a well-established Forex Brokerage environment

title: Elementor Expert (WordPress eCom Website Builder)
description:
We are looking for a skilled WordPress developer with strong Elementor experience to join our team and build high-performance websites for our marketing agency clients.


This role focuses on executing a proven build process , not designing sites from scratch. You’ll work from established Elementor Pro templates while inserting pre-generated content and images created by our internal AI systems.


If you enjoy working within clear systems and take pride in building clean, fast, and polished websites , this role will be a great fit.


Responsibilities


  • Build 3–4 WordPress websites per week using pre-built Elementor Pro templates
  • Insert AI-generated content into website layouts (all content is provided)
  • Adjust layouts and design elements to tailor each template for the client
  • Generate website visuals using AI image tools based on supplied prompts
  • Create simple design assets when needed using Canva
  • Integrate WooCommerce functionality for ecommerce websites
  • Ensure each website achieves extremely fast page load speeds (under 1 second)
  • Follow documented build processes and workflows precisely


Required Skills & Experience


  • Advanced proficiency with Elementor and Elementor Pro
  • Strong knowledge of WordPress performance optimization
  • Experience configuring WooCommerce within Elementor websites
  • Familiarity with AI image generation tools (Midjourney, DALL-E, OpenAI, etc.)
  • Basic graphic design ability and experience with Canva
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Available during EST business hours
  • Highly organized and comfortable working within defined processes


What This Role Focuses On


This role is about efficiently producing high-quality websites using a repeatable system .


You will not be responsible for writing content or designing full websites from scratch. Our automation tools generate the text and provide prompts for images. Your job is to assemble the site using templates, produce visuals, refine the layout, and ensure the final result is clean, professional, and extremely fast.


Important Note


⚡ Performance is critical.

Every site must achieve full page load speeds under 1 second without relying on caching solutions.


If you do not have strong experience optimizing WordPress for speed, this role will not be a good fit.


What We Provide


  • Managed hosting accounts
  • Elementor Pro licenses
  • AI-generated content for every site
  • Image prompts for generating visuals
  • Detailed documentation and build processes
  • A steady pipeline of website projects


Full-time role

Working hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (±1 hour flexibility)


Who We’re Looking For


The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, efficient, and process-driven . You take pride in producing polished work, enjoy following clear systems, and understand how small optimizations can dramatically impact website performance.


You’re comfortable using modern tools like AI image generators, you work quickly without sacrificing quality, and you care about delivering websites that are both visually clean and technically fast .

title: ASM Team Lead
description:

  • Prioritize incidents and changes together with Business teams and IT capabilities.

title: Coordenador(a) de Trade Marketing
description:
Nosso cliente, uma empresa nacional de grande relevância no setor alimentício busca um(a) Coordenador(a) Trade Marketing para atuar na categoria de perecíveis, com foco em execução estratégica, gestão de PDV e suporte às equipes comercial e de marketing.


Responsabilidades


Planejamento & Estratégia

  • Desenvolver o plano anual de Trade Marketing para a categoria, alinhado às metas comerciais.
  • Analisar consumidor, mercado e tendências para propor ações que aumentem presença, visibilidade e frequência de compra.
  • Contribuir para definições de sortimento e estratégia por canal.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar o trabalho dos promotores, incluindo treinamento e direcionamento.
  • Apoiar ativações e campanhas junto ao time de Marketing.


Execução no PDV

  • Criar e implementar campanhas sazonais e materiais de ponto de venda (expositores, wobblers, comunicação de preço etc.).
  • Garantir padronização da execução nas lojas, monitorando rupturas, giro e competitividade.


Relacionamento com Varejo e Distribuição

  • Atuar como interface entre Comercial, Marketing e clientes, assegurando a implementação das ações de trade.
  • Negociar pontos extras, espaços de destaque e oportunidades de visibilidade.
  • Oferecer suporte à equipe de vendas com materiais, argumentos e treinamentos.


Análises & Indicadores

  • Acompanhar KPIs como sell-in, sell-out, ruptura, estoque, margem e participação de gôndola.
  • Produzir relatórios de desempenho por canal, cliente e SKU, trazendo insights para decisões comerciais.


Gestão de Budget

  • Administrar o orçamento de Trade Marketing, controlar investimentos, custos de materiais e verbas cooperadas.
  • Garantir compliance e acompanhamento de ROI.


Desenvolvimento de Categoria

  • Sugerir melhorias de exposição, embalagens, layout e diferenciação da categoria, considerando atributos como frescor, origem, certificações e valor agregado.


Requisitos

  • Formação em Marketing, Publicidade, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Trade Marketing, preferencialmente em alimentos perecíveis ou bens de consumo de alto giro.
  • Conhecimento de varejo, atacarejo e/ou food service.
  • Boa capacidade analítica e domínio de ferramentas como Excel e Power BI.
  • Perfil organizado, comunicativo e com habilidade de negociação e relacionamento.

description:

Um especialista sênior que liderou a criação e gestão dos pipelines de dados que alimentam os modelos analíticos do projeto. Você será responsável por garantir a qualidade, integridade e disponibilidade dos dados para treinamento e inferência dos modelos de Machine Learning em produção. Esperamos que você oriente outros membros da equipe e defina estratégias de engenharia de dados e MLOps. Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.

  • MLOps: Experiência liderando a implementação de práticas de MLOps para versionamento, monitoramento e retreinamento automatizado de modelos.
  • Big Data: Habilidade para trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados em ecossistemas de Big Data (Data Lakes, Data Warehouses).


O que fazer em seguida

Caso você seja uma pessoa que está procurando, aguarde nosso contato para conhecê-lo melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Senior Director of Marketing, Edtech
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We’re seeking a results-oriented Senior Director of Marketing to lead global marketing and brand strategies for JoVE’s education and science research solutions. The ideal candidate will set the strategic vision, proactively develop and oversee the execution of data-driven programs to drive demand, accelerate revenue growth, and deepen brand engagement across educators, researchers, and librarians worldwide.


Responsibilities:


  • Develop and own the global marketing and brand strategy with a primary focus on generating qualified leads and converting them into meaningful engagement actions, including trial requests and product adoption.
  • Lead and scale a high-performing global marketing team of 20+ specialists across Campaigns, Outreach, Communications, and Events, owning performance and delivery against KPIs.
  • Drive initiatives that strengthen brand recognition and awareness while positioning JoVE as a go-to resource for education and science research.
  • Design and execute audience engagement strategies that attract, nurture, and convert prospects into trial users and active leads.
  • Plan and oversee the execution of integrated, multi-channel demand generation campaigns including email, social, webinars, events, and thought leadership.
  • Establish clear KPIs, and conversion metrics; monitor ROI and funnel impact, and continuously optimize programs to improve lead quality and conversion rates.


Requirements :


  • 10+ years of experience in marketing and brand. Experience in EdTech, academic publishing or SaaS is preferred.
  • 7+ years of management experience, successfully leading high-performing teams in a global environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively develop and execute innovative marketing programs that generate leads, convert them into engaged users (e.g., trials, demos, or similar engagement actions), and drive revenue growth.
  • Strong experience managing integrated, multi-channel marketing programs across email, social, events, webinars, content, and thought leadership.
  • Experience with Hubspot and Salesforce is required.
  • Results-driven, proactive, and thrives in a fast paced environment.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting an organization’s networks and data from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining security infrastructure (firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, etc.) and monitoring the network for vulnerabilities or incidents. The engineer will play a critical role in upholding Zero Trust security principles and ensuring high availability and integrity of network services in a dynamic, cloud-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, deploy, and maintain network security systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, encryption devices) to safeguard internal networks and cloud environments.
  • Threat Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activities; promptly investigate and respond to security incidents or breaches to minimize impact.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and remediate network weaknesses. Implement patches and updates to address vulnerabilities and ensure systems are protected against emerging threats.
  • Access Control & Policies: Enforce access controls and network segmentation (supporting a Zero Trust Network Access model) by administering firewalls and network access control lists. Develop and update network security policies, standards, and procedures to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Collaboration & Advisory: Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application developers, and security architects to integrate security measures into new projects and systems. Provide guidance on secure network design and educate team members on security best practices.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, incidents, and changes. Ensure all network security measures comply with relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and assist in preparing for security audits.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, etc.) and hands-on experience with network security technologies (firewalls such as Palo Alto/Cisco/Fortinet, IDS/IPS, VPN solutions, SIEM tools). Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls and routing/switching equipment in complex networks.
  • Security Expertise: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles , threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth, encryption, secure network design ). Ability to perform log analysis, intrusion detection, malware analysis basics, and incident handling.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing network and security issues. Ability to respond effectively under pressure during security incidents or outages.
